decisionsTitle: «Cere reconfirmarea»: «Vin» on the organizers' message, a ready reminder text, and a queue where every send to many waits behind the registrations' own emails
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-11**, on the reminder before the race, in his words:

1. «trebuie să trimit un mail de reminder, custom, în care să poată reconfirma sau anula pentru a da înscrierea mai departe»
2. «și mailul acela către toți participanții trebuie să fie default, dar vreau să fac preview mai întâi»
3. «și trebuie să mă asigur că nu blochez sistemul și trimit în batch-uri având în vedere că voi trimite 200 de mailuri»
4. «și vreau să fac și tracking dacă au apăsat că vin, gen să știu că au „reconfirmat”, dar e opțional»

Of the options put to him he picked «Butonul „Vin”» and «Text de reminder gata scris». What he asked for: a reminder with a ready text that asks who is coming, seen before it goes, and a send of two hundred that never holds up a runner's own emails. What his last sentence means here, kept true on every screen and in every text of this change:

1. the club sees who pressed «Vin»;
2. answering is optional — nothing in a state, a place, a deadline, the allocator or the capacity formula reads the answer;
3. «N-au răspuns» is information for the organizers, not a state;
4. nobody is cancelled automatically: the composer's help line says so, and the ready text says that «Vin» is optional and that not pressing it changes nothing about the registration.

**The two choices this builds.** «Vin» goes on the organizers' own message, «Trimite un mesaj participanților», behind a tick of the send — not on the automatic reminder; and the ready text is a button that fills the boxes, which the organizer may still change before sending.

### Part one: «Cere reconfirmarea», «Vin» and the ready text

**The tick.** The composer gets «Cere reconfirmarea» under the message, its help line «Emailul primește și butonul „Vin”. Nu se anulează nimeni automat; „N-au răspuns” e doar o informație pentru organizatori.» A send with it carries `askReconfirm: true` beside the words in the payload of exactly the rows whose registration it asks — the same `isReconfirmStatus` test at queue time that writes the ask row — so a send has two payloads, with and without the flag, each with its own «Trimite acum» mark (§540); the club's copy carries none. The audit row stays send-wide (`askReconfirm`, `asked`, `askedTest`). The flag is the row's because a send drains over days: an entry that was a waiting-list offer at send — reached by «Toți cei înscriși» but not asked — and accepted its offer before its row rendered would otherwise get «Vin» with no ask behind it, a button landing on a page with no question and a press refused. It gets «Nu mai pot ajunge» alone; a registration asked at send and no longer in an asked state when its row renders gets no «Vin» either (the render-time check in `reconfirmApplies`). The preview draws both buttons — «Vin» and «Nu mai pot ajunge» — on an inert example link (`${APP_BASE_URL}/<locale>/EXAMPLE#…`), as every `/admin/emails` preview does: no token is minted.

**The button.** «Vin» / "I'm coming" is a filled, full-width button in the club's ink blue just above «Nu mai pot ajunge», at least 48 pixels tall, its glyph the manage page's `EventAvailable` in white (`public/brand/email-reconfirm.png`, from `yarn brand:assets`), and one sentence under it: «Ne spui că vii. Nu e obligatoriu.» It uses the manage link the cancel already carries — the same `MANAGE_REGISTRATION` token minted at send time, at `#reconfirm` instead of `#cancel`: no new token purpose, no enum value. It goes only where «Nu mai pot ajunge» goes (the registration's own address, active, the event ahead and running) and only to a confirmed, pending-declaration or waiting registration (`RECONFIRM_STATUSES`); never on a club copy (§320). A waiting-list offer gets no «Vin»: its own email asks for the declaration.

**The page.** The manage page draws, for a registration a send asked while the event is ahead, «Vii la {event}?» with «Da, vin la cursă» — «Da, vin la eveniment» (and «Vii la eveniment?» when the title is missing) on an event that is not a race, by the event's type as the neighbours word it (a hike or a meetup takes registrations here too); never «Da, vin», which is the RSVP feature's word (§812) — the line «Răspunsul e opțional: dacă nu apeși „Da, vin la cursă”, nu se schimbă nimic la înscrierea ta.» (the button's own words) and the way out, «Nu mai poți ajunge? Folosește „Anulează înscrierea” mai jos.»; a pending declaration gets «Mai ai de semnat declarația: fără ea înscrierea nu e confirmată.», a waiting entry «Ești pe lista de așteptare; locul tău în ea nu se schimbă, oricum ai răspunde.» — never a sentence that makes the press sound like the way to keep a place — and an offer the sentence that points at its email. Once answered it reads «Am notat că vii — ne-ai răspuns {date}.»: when they answered, never the day they come. **The status sentence stays after the answer**: the pending declaration's and the waiting entry's lines are drawn whenever the question is drawn for a registration that is not an offer — before the press, during it and after the answer, above the green «Am notat că vii…» — so a person who still owes the declaration never reads the noted answer as being in. The GET writes nothing (BR-REQ-036-02 criterion 4). The POST reads the manage token through `readActionTokenContext` — the reader «Schimbă adresa» binds to the registration's current participant, so a link sent to an address the registration has left is answered as a missing token and records nothing — and never spends it: the same page still cancels. Under the row lock the registration is checked once more to be on the address the token was read for, so a «Schimbă adresa» that commits between the read and the lock is answered as a missing registration, nothing written. Per person (§547): a family member of the same address at the same event is accepted, a stranger refused. One transaction locks the registration, checks its state and its event, and answers every open ask of it — the answer is about the event, not one email — once: a second press writes nothing and makes no audit row, the first moment is kept («set, not flip»). A cancelled or expired registration, an event started or cancelled, or a registration nobody asked is answered «Răspunsul nu a fost înregistrat pentru această înscriere.» with nothing written — one sentence true for every refusal, since a registration nobody asked is still active. The audit row is `registration.reconfirmed`, no staff actor, `{ via: "MANAGE_LINK", sends }`, never a name; the trail labels it «A apăsat „Vin”, din linkul propriu» / "Pressed “I'm coming”, from their own link", the words the registration's page and «Toate datele unei persoane» already use.

**One press counts.** The email's «Vin» opens the manage page at `#reconfirm`, and there the page presses «Da, vin la cursă» by itself, once — the pattern of the decision «The «Vii?» card and «Cine vine» are closed folds, and the «Da, vin» link counts you when it opens»: one small client island (`ReconfirmOnArrival`) submits the page's existing form through the existing server action, a POST, only while the page is shown and not prerendered; the GET still writes nothing, so a scanner that only fetches the link counts nobody, and with scripts off the question and its button stay and work. After the POST the page shows the noted answer and draws no island; a refusal is shown once and never retried; an answered question, `#cancel` and a bare manage link press nothing; only the token's own registration is pressed, never another person of the same address. While that POST is in flight the form's button wears its pending label, «Notăm că vii…» / "Noting that you're coming…" (the shared submit button, as on the «Da, vin» link page), so nobody reads «Răspunsul e opțional…» under a page that seems to do nothing. The answer's page replaces the page that pressed in the history (the action's redirect replaces instead of pushing), so Back leaves the manage page: it never mounts the island again, spends no attempt and bounces nobody forward. So the ready text's «apasă-l», the email's «Ne spui că vii.» and the guide's «Cine apasă „Vin” apare cu «A reconfirmat»» are true as written: whoever opens «Vin» in a browser that runs the page is counted.

**What is recorded.** One table, `registration_reconfirmations` — one row per registration asked per send (`registration_id`, `event_id`, `send_id`, `asked_at`, `reconfirmed_at`), unique per registration and send, cascading with the registration and with the event; migration `0200_registration_reconfirmations`, expand only, nothing backfilled. Written inside the send's own transaction, test registrations too (AGENTS.md §12.6). A table and not columns on `registrations`, because a second send's ask would overwrite the first's numbers; not derived from the outbox, because its sent rows are swept. «Schimbă adresa» re-addresses a waiting message with its payload, so the flag travels with the row; the asks belong to the registration and stay with it.

**What staff see.** The chip «A reconfirmat» (`StatusChip glyph="reconfirmed"`) on a list row whose person said «Vin» and is still registered; the filter «Reconfirmare» — «Au reconfirmat · Au anulat după cerere · N-au răspuns» — one `EXISTS` in the list's one `WHERE`, so its count, its pages, its summary and its export follow it; on each «Mesaje trimise» row of a send that asked, «Au reconfirmat {yes} · Au anulat {cancelled} · N-au răspuns {none}», one grouped query for the whole history, test registrations left out; one line on the registration's page, «A apăsat „Vin” {date}.» — when they answered, never the day they come; the export column «Reconfirmat» after «Partener», «Note interne» still the last; «Toate datele unei persoane» lists each ask and its answer («a apăsat „Vin” {at}», the moment in its inline form). **One rule for «a reconfirmat», on every screen:** a registration has re-confirmed when any of its asks — this send's or another's of the event — is answered. Of the registrations a send asked, «Au reconfirmat» counts the still registered with some answered ask, «N-au răspuns» those with none that can still answer (`RECONFIRM_STATUSES`: an entry holding a waiting-list offer has no button and is not silent) — the list's filter reads the same set —, «Au anulat după cerere» those cancelled at or after this send's ask. So a person who pressed «Vin» after the first reminder and stays silent after the second counts under «Au reconfirmat» on both «Mesaje trimise» rows, as the list's chip, its filter and the export's «Reconfirmat» say; the manage page still offers the question while an ask is open. Still one grouped read for the whole history (a correlated `EXISTS` inside the `FILTER`), test registrations left out. An expired registration is in none of the three. A structural guard (`tests/unit/registrations/reconfirmation-never-leaves.test.ts`) keeps the answer off every public page but the person's own manage page, out of the email's renderer (which reads only the flag and the link), the desk, the sponsors' file, the allocator, the capacity formula and the maintenance job.

**The ready text.** «Completează cu textul de reminder», above the subject, writes the four boxes from the catalogues — Romanian into the Romanian boxes and English into the English ones, whatever the backoffice's language, the placeholders literal — and ticks «Cere reconfirmarea»; it asks «Înlocuiești textul scris?» first when a box already holds words. The text: «Ne vedem la {eventTitle}? Spune-ne dacă vii» / "See you at {eventTitle}? Tell us if you're coming", then seven paragraphs — the greeting; when and where («{eventTitle} e aproape: …» / "{eventTitle} is coming up: …"); «Dacă vii și vezi butonul „Vin” mai jos, apasă-l. Așa știm pe cine așteptăm.» (a waiting-list offer reached by «Toți cei înscriși» gets no «Vin», so the sentence does not promise one); «Dacă nu mai poți ajunge, apasă „Nu mai pot ajunge”, ca să poată veni altcineva în locul tău.» (not a waiting person's «place» promised to the waiting list); **«„Vin” e opțional: dacă nu-l apeși, nu se schimbă nimic la înscrierea ta.»** (not «rămâne exact cum e», false for somebody who still owes the declaration or holds an offer with a deadline); «Dacă mai ai de semnat declarația sau ai primit un loc oferit, urmează pașii din emailul primit.» / "If you still have to sign the declaration or were offered a place, follow the steps in the email you received." (no deadline promised: an offer or a declaration may have none in its email); and the thanks. Every placeholder is one the subject can fill. The guide's send step says what the window and «Mesaje trimise» tell: «…fereastra spune cât durează și dacă încap toate acum. În «Mesaje trimise» vezi câte au plecat și câți au reconfirmat.» — «câte pleacă azi» is said by the window only on a daily plan.

### Part two: the queue's order, and what the Administrator is told about a send

**The order.** On each road the outbox claims, each step oldest first and in the room the steps before it left: (0) a registration's own messages — every type that is neither a send to many nor bulk — and an Administrator's «Retrimite» of any type for one runner (`is_manual_resend`), which is that runner's own message; then the sends to many, the most urgent first: (1) «{event} a fost anulat» (`EVENT_CANCELLED`) — somebody may be about to travel to a race that will not run; (2) «Detalii actualizate» (`EVENT_UPDATE_NOTICE`); (3) the automatic reminder (`EVENT_REMINDER`); (4) «Trimite un mesaj participanților» (`ORGANIZER_MESSAGE`); (5) the thanks, «Trimite mulțumirile» (`EVENT_THANKS`), the afternoon of the race, nothing in it to act on; (6) «s-au deschis înscrierile» (`REGISTRATION_OPENED`), to addresses with no registration yet; then (7) the bulk ones under their cap (§445). Steps 1–6 are one constant, `SEND_TO_MANY_MESSAGE_TYPES` in `notifications/domain/bulk.ts`, its docblock saying why each is there and why in its place: one message per registration (or per address that asked) queued by one press or one job, about two hundred at a time. The first review's list named three; the cancellation, the thank-you and the announcement are queued the same way and stood in front of a verification queued after them. A club copy rides with its type, and `BULK_CLUB_COPY_MESSAGES` again means only which types get one club copy per send. Steps 0–6 have no cap, so one ordered claim takes them; the bulk keeps its own claim for its cap. The same order for a press's own rows («Trimite acum», §540) and in the batch handed to the worker. A verification queued after a burst of two hundred of any of them — or a waiting-list offer queued after the reminder's two hundred, which the maintenance job queues in one transaction a reminder lead before the start — leaves in the next batch, and the burst still drains completely, none sent twice; a manual resend of one runner's reminder queued after the job's two hundred leaves in the next pass. Nothing drops, doubles or stales a send to many that now waits minutes behind the registrations' own messages, read for each: the cancellation and «Detalii actualizate» are keyed once per save and registration, follow a moved address («Schimbă adresa») and are withdrawn by no render for waiting; the reminder keeps its once-per-registration key and the start is a reminder lead away; the thank-you is claimed once per event by `thanks_sent_at` and keyed once per registration; the announcement is keyed once per address that asked, its address row deleted in the same transaction, and the retention sweep takes such a row only after ninety days.

**During a Mailgun stop Gmail carries the registrations' own messages and the event's urgent notices.** With «Gmail preia când Mailgun se oprește» in force, the carried path claims on Gmail's road the registrations' own messages (a manual resend among them) and the event's two urgent notices — the cancellation (`EVENT_CANCELLED`) and «Detalii actualizate» (`EVENT_UPDATE_NOTICE`), named once beside the order as `URGENT_SEND_TO_MANY_MESSAGE_TYPES` — in the place the order gives them, as Gmail carried them before this change: each says something a person acts on at once. The other sends to many on Mailgun's road — the reminder, the organizers' message, the thanks and «s-au deschis înscrierile» —, like the bulk kind, are not carried. One predicate says which, `waitsForMailgunDuringStop` (a send to many, not a manual resend, not one of the two), and the carried claim, the hand-back, the sender's flag, `/api/health` and the queue panel all read it. The carried claim gives the rows it leaves behind the stop's end as their turn, in its own transaction — no mark written, no attempt spent — so the job's plan reads no work due now on every ping until then (the club's database is capped); one that the stop catches mid-batch is handed back for the same instant, its attempt given back; they are sent with the bulk flag, so a refusal by Mailgun never spills them to Gmail; and they leave by Mailgun, in their order, when the stop ends. One whose own road is Gmail leaves by Gmail, as its road says; and a press's own «Trimite acum» rows on the queue panel (§540) leave by Gmail as the press said, since the press is let through only with room in Gmail's day for every message of it (`assertRoomToSendNow`). «Trimite un mesaj participanților» offers no «Trimite acum» while Mailgun is stopped (below). So a send of two hundred never spends Gmail's day: its room stays for the address to confirm, the declaration, the offer and the urgent notices, and the dialog's sentences about a daily plan are true. The queue panel and «Emailuri azi» say such a row leaves after Mailgun resumes. `/api/health` reports the stop itself (`mailgunStop`, `degraded` while Gmail carries), counts a row given the stop's end as waiting — never as deferred, overdue or a provider's error, since nothing refused it — and counts one that Mailgun refused and marked as any row nothing carries: paused late once it was queued longer ago than the overdue allowance.

**The bulk hold never carries a stop mark into the future — a defect of the released code, found by this review with a probe and fixed here.** The newsletter's hold (`holdBulkUntilReset`, §445) moves every due bulk row to the next reset. A due row still wearing Mailgun's stop mark («paused by the provider: …» after a 429, or «allowance spent: …») kept it, and the stop reader (`readMailgunStop`: a marked row whose turn is ahead) then read Mailgun's whole road as stopped until the next reset — up to sixteen hours — no verification, offer or confirmation left by Mailgun until then, and the public page said the emails were paused. Now the hold clears those two marks on the rows it moves and keeps any other reason: a due row's stop has ended, and a stop in force lives in `platform_settings.mailgunStop`, which the hold never touches. Cleared rather than left out of the hold, because a row left out stays due and the job's plan would read work due now on every ping until the reset.

**No reserve.** The first build kept `max(10, 10%)` of a daily allowance (10% of a monthly one) for the registrations' own emails: a cap on the staff sends per pass, the rest held until the allowance's reset and marked. The review of the merged tree, with probes, found that the hold could close Mailgun's road — it kept Mailgun's pause and allowance marks on the rows it moved to the reset, and the stop reader then read Mailgun as stopped, so no verification, offer or confirmation left by Mailgun until the next reset — up to sixteen hours; the newsletter's own hold had the same defect, fixed above — that it rang `/api/health` with false «stalled» answers during a normal drain, and that it showed visitors a false «emailurile întârzie»; and on the monthly plan the club is on for the race it would never have acted. Version one therefore orders and tells the truth, and keeps no reserve (decided for the owner, below). The sends to many get no cap, no hold and no mark; the newsletter's own reserve (§445) is unchanged.

**What health and the public pages read.** A send to many waiting past its turn is not late by that alone — on `/api/health` and in the queue panel's «late», one judgement: it waits behind the registrations' own messages and drains at the queue's pace. Probed on a monthly plan with the hourly pace cleared, 201 organizers' messages queued at 10:00 and a pass every fifteen minutes read «stalled» from 11:45 before this change, and `ok` at every pass until the last left at 12:30 now; the reminder's 200 the same. What still catches a real stall: a scheduler that stopped is the job check's; a provider's refusal, pause or stop on such a row is counted by the other buckets — deferred, paused late, stopped late, retrying late, failed — as on any row; a registration's own message whose turn passed is late as before — and so is a manual resend of a send to many, the person's own message: health, the queue panel and the public check read the type and the resend flag together (`waitsAsSendToMany`). The public «emailurile întârzie» counts a send to many neither as a message a visitor waits for nor as queued ahead of a new registration's email; its one query now groups by the resend flag too, so a manual resend counts ahead.

**Before «Trimite».** Worded on the server, on the road the send really takes — the participants' on their group's road, the club's copy on its own — and true in every state it can be drawn in:

1. **Mailgun's road, no daily ceiling** (a monthly plan, or none): the pace «Pleacă treptat, câte 20 la 15 minute ziua (noaptea mai rar): cam {hours} ore pe ritmul de zi.» — or «cel mult {hourly} pe oră» when Mailgun's hour is the slower —, «Încape în cota lunii.» or «Luna aceasta pot pleca {now} dintre ele; restul așteaptă la coadă și pleacă când se reface cota lunară. Nu se pierde niciunul.», and the assurance «Emailurile înscrierilor pleacă înaintea lor.» / "The registrations' own emails leave before them.".
2. **A daily ceiling** (Free): how many can leave today — what the day's allowance has left less what already waits ahead on Mailgun's road, counted as the claim's order runs it: the registrations' own and the manual resends, the cancellation, «Detalii actualizate», the reminder and the older organizers' messages, never the thanks or «s-au deschis înscrierile», which leave after it (`volume.waitingAhead`, one grouped read) — with the hours of those alone, and «restul» over at least N more days at most the allowance a day: «Azi pot pleca 95 dintre ele; restul așteaptă la coadă și pleacă în cel puțin încă 2 zile, cel mult 100 pe zi, cât lasă cota refăcută la miezul nopții (UTC). Nu se pierde niciunul.» — never a number before «the rest» («celelalte 1 așteaptă» was ungrammatical). When the send does not fit today, a warning in the warning colour, in the dialog and on the composer: «Pe un plan cu cotă zilnică, mesajul acesta folosește cota zilnică în cel puțin 3 zile. Emailurile înscrierilor pleacă înaintea lui și din aceeași cotă: după ce se termină cota zilei, Mailgun nu mai trimite nimic în ziua aceea, nici emailurile înscrierilor.» — «…, iar ele pleacă prin Gmail-ul clubului.» only where the page reads that «Gmail preia când Mailgun se oprește» is in force, which after the change above carries them and the event's urgent notices, never this send — «Un mesaj mare se trimite pe un plan lunar: «Setări» → «Emailuri» → «Planul Mailgun și cât mai putem trimite».». Checked for 201 on Free's 100 a day with 5 sent: 95 today, then 100 and 6, the daily allowance used on at least three days.
3. **The club's Gmail road**: no Mailgun sentence and no literal duration — «Emailuri prin Gmail-ul clubului: 201. Gmail mai poate trimite acum {room} din limita de {cap}.», its pace a pass («Pleacă prin Gmail-ul clubului, câte 4 la 15 minute ziua …»), and always «Limita Gmail e comună cu celelalte emailuri care pleacă prin Gmail-ul clubului.» — after «Încape acum în limita Gmail.» when the send fits, and as the dialog's warning when it does not fit the room now. Then «Acum pot pleca 200 dintre ele; restul așteaptă să se facă loc în limita Gmail de 200. …», or, when the club set Mailgun at Gmail's cap, «Prin Gmail pot pleca acum 200 dintre ele; restul pleacă prin Mailgun, cum e setat la limita Gmail, și se scade din cota Mailgun.».
4. **Mailgun stopped now** (read once on the page with the day's volume, as `/api/health` reads it): on Mailgun's road one more sentence, «Mailgun e oprit acum, până {until}. Mesajul începe să plece când repornește.», and no sentence of what leaves now, today or this month stands beside it; the pace and, on a daily plan, the warning stay. And the dialog then offers no «Trimite acum»: «now» would either send the whole group by the club's Gmail at once or be refused, both against the line, so the press queues and the message waits as the line says. The queue panel's own «Trimite acum» for chosen rows keeps its exception, an Administrator's deliberate press.

The cost line beside the composer follows the same roads: «… — se scad din cota Mailgun …» only for what Mailgun carries, the club's copy said apart when it goes by Gmail, and Gmail's own line on its road. The road the dialog offers to switch (§841) is the group's setting; the line describes that road. No start time is promised: «Când pleacă emailurile» says when the first leaves.

**Progress.** Each «Mesaje trimise» row shows «Au plecat {left} · Așteaptă {waiting}» (and «Nu au plecat {failed}» when some failed), one grouped query over the outbox by send, test registrations left out; hidden once the retention job has swept the sent rows.

### Decided for the owner (the defaults; each can change)

1. **No reserve.** The order keeps the registrations' own emails first on every plan and road; on a daily plan they share the allowance with the send, and the dialog says so before «Trimite». A reserve held rows in a way that could close Mailgun's road and ring false alarms, and would not act on the race month's plan.
2. **The Mailgun plan for the race week: no code change.** `docs/OWNER-TODO.md` item 24 moves Mailgun to Basic on 1 November: on Basic, 201 messages fit the month and leave in about three hours at 20 every 15 minutes, the registrations' own emails first. Should the plan stay on Free, the same 201 leave over three days — 95 today with 5 already sent, then 100 a day — and the dialog warns that the send uses the daily allowance on at least three days, that the registrations' own emails share it and that once a day's is spent Mailgun sends nothing more that day, and where the monthly plan is chosen; or «Anunțuri» can go through the club's Gmail on «Setări» → «Emailuri» (its own cap; no Mailgun allowance spent).
3. **«Au anulat după cerere»** counts any cancellation at or after the ask — the participant's or an Administrator's. The alternative was the participant's own only.
4. **One press counts**, by his own choice on the sibling page: of the «Da, vin» link page he said, 2026-10-19, «Asta ar trebui să se auto-bifeze când deschid»; here he asked to know who pressed «Vin» (his fourth sentence above). Accepted: a mail scanner that runs scripts could count somebody — the answer changes nothing about the registration, and the person's «Nu mai pot ajunge» is beside it. Refused: a second press named in every text (more words, and a silent under-count of everyone who presses «Vin» and closes the tab), and an auto-submit from the GET (refused there and here: a GET writes nothing).
5. **«Gmail preia când Mailgun se oprește» no longer sends a send of two hundred through the club's Gmail.** During a Mailgun stop it carries the registrations' own emails and the event's urgent notices — the cancellation and «Detalii actualizate» — so Gmail's daily room stays for them; the reminder, the organizers' message, the thanks and «s-au deschis înscrierile» wait for Mailgun and leave when it resumes. The alternative he may choose instead: the switch as it was, every group by Gmail during a stop, a large send using up Gmail's room for the day.

### For the lawyer

The privacy notice already covers the organizers' messages (art. 6(1)(b)) and keeps registration data for the registration's life; no legal text or template is changed here. Two sentences for the next review:

1. «Clubul păstrează, la o înscriere, dacă și când participantul a apăsat „Vin” într-un mesaj al organizatorilor; nu schimbă înscrierea și se șterge odată cu ea.»
2. «Nota nu numește încă acest răspuns; o versiune viitoare îl poate numi explicit.»

### Refused in version one

- **An automatic cancel of those who do not answer.** Answering is optional; a missed email must never cost a place.
- **An automatic second reminder.** The club sends another by hand; a job would be a new automatic email.
- **Changing `EVENT_REMINDER`.** It goes to every confirmed registration on its schedule (AGENTS.md §16.3); asking there would ask everybody, every time.
- **Anything on a public page.** Who said «Vin» is the organizers' information, not a disclosure (§10.10).
- **A deadline to answer, or a state for the silent.** «N-au răspuns» is a count, never a status the allocator could read.
- **A second press, or a write on the GET.** One press counts through the page's own POST (decided above); a GET that recorded would count every link scanner.
- **A reserve on a daily plan.** The first build's hold could close Mailgun's road until the next reset — up to sixteen hours —, ring false alarms and show visitors a false delay; the order and the warning before «Trimite» tell the truth instead, and on the monthly plan the club is on for the race a reserve would never act.
changelogLine: - **«Cere reconfirmarea» and «Vin»** — a tick on «Trimite un mesaj participanților» puts «Vin» beside «Nu mai pot ajunge» in the email of every registration the send asks; opening «Vin» in a browser is one press — the person's own page presses «Da, vin la cursă» by itself, says it is noting the answer, still says what is owed after it, and Back does not press again; without scripts the button stays — recorded once, optional and changing nothing, and staff see «A reconfirmat» (any answered ask), a three-way filter, the counts on «Mesaje trimise» and a «Reconfirmat» column; «Completează cu textul de reminder» fills both languages; the outbox now sends a registration's own emails first (a manual resend among them), then the cancellation, «Detalii actualizate», the automatic reminder, the organizers' messages, the thank-you and «s-au deschis înscrierile», the newsletter last; during a Mailgun stop Gmail carries the registrations' own emails and the event's urgent notices (the cancellation, «Detalii actualizate») while the other sends wait for Mailgun, and «Trimite un mesaj participanților» offers no «Trimite acum» then; the newsletter's hold no longer keeps Mailgun's road closed until the next reset; and the question before «Trimite» says how the send leaves on the road it takes, Mailgun stopped included, with a warning on a daily plan it does not fit. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an organizer's message sent with «Cere reconfirmarea» to a confirmed, pending-declaration or waiting registration of an event still ahead, when the person opens «Vin» then the manage page's GET asks «Vii la {event}?» with «Da, vin la cursă» and writes nothing, and a browser that runs its scripts presses that button once by itself at `#reconfirm` through the page's own POST — never at `#cancel` or on a bare link, never for another person of the address, never again after an answer or a refusal, its button wearing its pending label while that POST is in flight, and the answer's page replacing the page that pressed in the history so that Back presses nothing; without scripts the button stays and records on its press; after the answer a registration owing the declaration still reads «Mai ai de semnat declarația: fără ea înscrierea nu e confirmată.» (a waiting entry its line), above the noted answer; the POST reads the manage token through the reader bound to the registration's current participant, checks that participant again under the row lock, never spends the token, records the first moment once (a second press writes nothing and audits nothing) and changes no state, place, hold or deadline; a waiting-list offer, a cancelled or expired registration, an event started or cancelled, or a link of an address the registration has left records nothing (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Cere reconfirmarea», when a send or its preview is asked then only a role that may message the participants (the Organizer and above) is served and every other role is refused FORBIDDEN with no ask written (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given who said «Vin», when any page, email or file is inspected then it is read only by the person's own manage page (the noted answer) and by the backoffice's list, the registration's page, «Mesaje trimise», the registrations' Excel and CSV and «Toate datele unei persoane», and by no other public page, email, desk, sponsors' file, allocator or capacity term (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a send with «Cere reconfirmarea» to «Toți cei înscriși», when its rows render then «Vin» is drawn only in the email of a registration the send asked: the flag is in the payload of exactly the rows that got an ask row (each with its own «Trimite acum» mark, none on the club's copy, the audit send-wide); an entry that was a waiting-list offer at send and accepted it before its row rendered gets «Nu mai pot ajunge», no «Vin» and has no ask row; one asked at send and no longer in an asked state at render gets no «Vin»; the preview still shows both buttons (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given two asking sends of an event, a person answering after the first and silent after the second, when «Mesaje trimise», the registrations list's chip, its filter «Reconfirmare» and the export are read then all say re-confirmed — a registration has re-confirmed when any of its asks is answered; «N-au răspuns» counts, on «Mesaje trimise» and in the filter alike, only a registration that can still answer (confirmed, owed the declaration or waiting) with no answered ask, so an entry holding a waiting-list offer is never silent; «Au anulat după cerere» is unchanged, the history's numbers stay one grouped read and leave test registrations out (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given due rows of every kind on a road, when the outbox claims a batch then it takes, each step oldest first and in the room the steps before it left, a registration's own messages — an Administrator's manual resend of any type among them —, then the cancellation, «Detalii actualizate», the reminder, the organizers' message, the thank-you and «s-au deschis înscrierile» (`SEND_TO_MANY_MESSAGE_TYPES`, a club copy with its type), then the bulk ones under their cap — for a press's own rows too, the batch handed to the worker in that order; a verification queued after 200 rows of any of them, a «Detalii actualizate» queued after the burst and a waiting-list offer queued after the reminder's 200 rows each leave first, the burst drains completely and none is sent twice, and a manual resend of one runner's reminder queued after the job's 200 leaves in the next pass; no row of the sends to many is capped, held or marked, so a row of theirs Mailgun paused, once due again, leaves Mailgun's road open, also when a daily allowance is spent (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a send to many draining at the queue's pace — 201 organizers' messages or 200 reminders queued at 10:00 on a monthly plan, a pass every fifteen minutes — when `/api/health` is read at every pass then it answers `ok` until the last row leaves; a registration's own message whose turn passed by the allowance — or a manual resend of a send to many — still reads `stalled`, an organizers' message a provider keeps refusing is still counted as retrying or failed, and the public «emailurile întârzie» neither counts such rows nor puts them ahead of a new registration's email (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a send of 201 messages, when the question before «Trimite» is drawn then it is worded on the road the send takes, its club copy counted on its own road, and no sentence of it counts «the rest» with a number: on Mailgun with no daily ceiling, the pace, that it fits the month and «Emailurile înscrierilor pleacă înaintea lor.»; on Free's 100 a day with 5 sent, 95 today in about two hours, the rest over at least two more days at 100 a day, and a warning in the dialog and on the composer that it uses the daily allowance on at least three days, that the registrations' own emails leave first and share it and that once a day's is spent Mailgun sends nothing more that day — by the club's Gmail then only while «Gmail preia când Mailgun se oprește» is in force — and where a monthly plan is chosen; on the club's Gmail, Gmail's room and pace with no literal duration and no Mailgun sentence, always that Gmail's limit is shared with the club's other Gmail emails — the dialog's warning when the send does not fit the room now — and the rest waiting for room or, as set at Gmail's cap, leaving by Mailgun against its allowance; and while Mailgun is stopped, on its road, one sentence saying until when and that the message starts leaving when it restarts, with no sentence of what leaves now or today beside it (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 12 (amended): Given the composer, when a group is chosen, then it says how many emails the send costs on the road they take: on Mailgun's road «Emailuri, cu tot cu copiile pentru club: N — se scad din cota Mailgun (…)», or, when the club's copies go by the club's Gmail, «Emailuri: N — se scad din cota Mailgun (…). Copiile pentru club, C, pleacă prin Gmail-ul clubului.», the parenthesis naming the plan with what it has left today or this month and how many already wait in the queue; on the club's Gmail road «Emailuri prin Gmail-ul clubului: N. Gmail mai poate trimite acum R din limita de L.», with no Mailgun allowance. When the room left is smaller, it says how many can leave now — today or this month on Mailgun, now on Gmail — and that «restul» wait in the queue until the allowance or Gmail's room comes back, «Nu se pierde niciunul.», or leave by Mailgun against its allowance where the club set that at Gmail's limit, never with a number before «restul»; while Mailgun is stopped it says no such count on Mailgun's road. It never refuses the send for it (§40) (2026-09-24, `DECISIONS.md` §364; amended 2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 38 (amended): Given the outbox, when a public page asks whether the club's emails are late, then one query answers it (the rows not yet sent and those sent in the last ninety minutes, grouped by type, club copy and manual resend, with the email plan and the transport setting), never counting the newsletter, the new-event alert, a send to many — the cancellation, «Detalii actualizate», the reminder, the organizers' message, the thank-you and «s-au deschis înscrierile», which the claim takes after every registration's own message, and which are never counted ahead of it either, though a manual resend of one is counted ahead as the person's own —, the club's copies and archives, a staff or member invitation or a row a family's sitting holds — told only by its markers (`sittingHeld`, `familyHeld`, the family confirmation's `familySittingId`) while its not-before is ahead — and counting every other unsent row from its creation (a family's row, its hold over, from the instant it was let go, which the family's path records in the payload as `heldUntil` with every not-before it sets and rewrites to now at «Gata» — never from `next_attempt_at`, so a failed attempt after the release moves nothing; a marked row without it from its not-before when no provider gave a reason, else from its creation), a row handed to a later run (Gmail's pace, Mailgun's pause, a deferral) included, without the sending path writing anything new on any row; with an estimate that is never below when a spent hour frees its first place, a pause ends or an allowance resets, plus the scheduler's tick at that instant (the promised wait under the cadence then in force — the night's hour for a reset at 02:05 seen by day); it is served from the data cache under its own tag `public:email` for sixty seconds (a static page's render at the day's ceiling under its own key), with no saved copy; and `processOutboxBatch` expires that tag once per batch that sent, deferred, gave up on or withdrew a message, and never for a batch that claimed nothing or only scheduled a retry (2026-10-01, `DECISIONS.md` §623; amended 2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 39 (amended): Given one outbox claim with a limit — the batch size, the room Mailgun's hour leaves or the newsletter's cap — whatever the table's statistics say, an outbox emptied and vacuumed included, then it marks at most that many rows PROCESSING, in the claim's order — a registration's own messages first (a manual resend of any type among them), then the cancellation, «Detalii actualizate», the reminder, the organizers' message, the thank-you and «s-au deschis înscrierile», each oldest first: one `SELECT … LIMIT … FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` picks the ids and the UPDATE changes exactly those (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §644; amended 2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 6 (amended): Given an outbox row deferred by the provider's allowance, one whose turn passed more than ninety minutes ago — never a send to many (`SEND_TO_MANY_MESSAGE_TYPES`: the cancellation, «Detalii actualizate», the reminder, the organizers' message, the thank-you, «s-au deschis înscrierile») for waiting its turn behind the registrations' own messages, while an Administrator's manual resend of one is judged as the person's own message —, or one that spent every attempt in the last seven days, when `/api/health` answers, then it reports `email.status = stalled`, an overall `degraded`, and HTTP 503 — every status but `ok` is a 503 — so an external monitor that notifies on a non-2xx tells the club that email has stopped through a channel that is not email; a send to many is still counted by the deferred, paused-late, stopped-late, retrying-late and failed counts as any row is; the same counts, the reason and the resume time are shown on `/admin/tasks` and `/devs`; a bounce alone is not a stall (`DECISIONS.md` §98; amended 2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 18 (amended): Given a PENDING row waiting out Gmail's rolling-day cap because the club chose to wait, when /api/health answers, then it is not counted as deferred and does not make the email block stalled; it is reported as `email.gmail.deferred` with `email.gmail.resumesAt`, and becomes overdue like any row once its turn has passed undrained — a send to many excepted, which criterion 6 (amended) never calls overdue for waiting its turn; a Mailgun deferral beside it still answers 503 (2026-09-27, `DECISIONS.md` §493; amended 2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `notifications/email-health.test.ts`.

Criterion 32 (amended): Given Mailgun's road is stopped — a pause it asked for, or its allowance spent — and «Gmail preia când Mailgun se oprește» is on where Gmail is configured and the privacy notice in force names `{{gmailFallback}}` in every language, when the outbox claims, then it takes nothing from Mailgun's road and claims on Gmail's road the due rows of the registrations' own messages, of the event's urgent notices — the cancellation and «Detalii actualizate» — and every row whose own road is Gmail — never another send to many nor the newsletter's kind on Mailgun's road, which wait for Mailgun (criterion 36 (amended)) —, the rows Mailgun held back due at once, inside Gmail's own cap and pace, each sent by Gmail alone with `transport = gmail`; a row Gmail cannot take waits with its attempt for Gmail's room or Mailgun's return and is never sent to Mailgun during the stop; the stop stays recorded after the refused row has left, a pause holds Mailgun's road with or without an hourly pace, a family sitting neither stretches nor ends it (its replace may delete a paused row, the stop being recorded apart from it, and a first email paused before «Da» is still the sitting's, so the family message replaces it and the address gets one message), and when the pause ends or the reset comes Mailgun's groups return to Mailgun; with the switch off nothing moves on Mailgun's road during a pause (2026-10-01, `DECISIONS.md` §622; amended 2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 35 (amended): Given Mailgun is stopped, when «Trimite acum» on the queue panel or a resend's «now» is pressed, then with the switch on and room in Gmail's day the messages leave through Gmail and the page says «N prin Gmail — Mailgun în pauză până la HH:MM» or «… cota Mailgun epuizată până la …», and otherwise the press is refused with a sentence naming the cause and the remedy and nothing is sent — or, when a row on Gmail's own road was due, goes ahead and says when Mailgun reopens, as does a press during which Mailgun announces the stop with nothing to carry it; «Trimite un mesaj participanților» offers no «Trimite acum» while the stop is drawn, so its press queues; the queue panel's header names the stop, until when and what Gmail carries; `/api/health?deep=1` reports `email.status = degraded` while Gmail carries the registrations' own messages and the event's urgent notices — the other sends to many waiting for Mailgun, counted as waiting — and `stalled` (a 503) once a row has waited ninety minutes with nothing to carry it; and «Sarcini»'s row «Emailuri pe care nu le duce nimeni» is red, with the switch, what Gmail carries and what waits for Mailgun, Gmail's cap, «Reîncearcă emailurile eșuate» and «Limita pe oră» in its steps, while such a row or a FAILED row of the last seven days exists (2026-10-01, `DECISIONS.md` §622; amended 2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 36 (amended): Given Mailgun's road is stopped and Gmail carries for it, when the outbox claims or a refused message would spill, then a newsletter, a new-event alert or a send to many that waits for Mailgun (`waitsForMailgunDuringStop`: the reminder, the organizers' message, the thank-you, «s-au deschis înscrierile»; never a manual resend, nor the cancellation or «Detalii actualizate», which Gmail carries) stays on Mailgun's road and waits for its return — not claimed, its turn set to the stop's end in the claim's own transaction so the job's plan reads no work due now until then, no mark written, no attempt spent, one caught mid-batch handed back for the same instant with its attempt given back, never spilled to Gmail — and leaves by Mailgun in the claim's order once the stop ends, unless the club routed that group to Gmail, where it leaves by Gmail, or it is a press's own «Trimite acum» row on the queue panel, which the press let through only with Gmail's room for all of it; and given the allowance stop was recorded and the Administrator saves «Planul Mailgun», then the record is deleted and the allowance-deferred rows are due now, so the next claim sends them on Mailgun's road (2026-10-01, `DECISIONS.md` §622; amended 2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 52 (amended): Amends criterion 23. Given a waiting row on the queue panel or «Emailuri azi», then its departure is one judgement for both: «Pleacă după ce Mailgun reia» with the hour while Mailgun is stopped and nothing carries a Mailgun-road row, or a Free plan's day is spent — under the «imediat» timing too, whose drain claims no such row — and for a send to many on Mailgun's road that waits for Mailgun while Gmail carries the stop (the reminder, the organizers' message, the thank-you, «s-au deschis înscrierile»; not the cancellation or «Detalii actualizate», which Gmail carries), its turn the stop's end included; «Pleacă acum» while the «imediat» timing's drain is still sending a row queued a moment ago and never tried, on a road open to it, and for a press's own «Trimite acum»; the late mark is health's: never on a send to many for waiting its turn, and on a manual resend of one as on the person's own message (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §912; amended 2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a daily plan whose bulk budget is spent and a newsletter row due again that still wears Mailgun's pause mark or its allowance mark, when the outbox's pass holds the bulk until the next reset, then the row is moved to the reset without the mark — any other reason kept — so the stop reader reads no stop, a verification queued afterwards is sent by Mailgun, and with «Gmail preia când Mailgun se oprește» in force it is not carried by Gmail (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given Mailgun stopped by a pause or by a spent daily allowance and «Gmail preia când Mailgun se oprește» in force, when the outbox runs, then a verification and then the cancellation and «Detalii actualizate» are carried by Gmail in the claim's order, while a reminder, an organizers' message, a thank-you and «s-au deschis înscrierile» on Mailgun's road are not claimed — their turn the stop's end, no mark, no attempt spent, so the job's plan reads no work due now until then — and once the stop ends they leave by Mailgun in the claim's order, marked so that Mailgun's refusal never spills them to Gmail; a stop that begins mid-batch hands such rows back for its end with their attempt given back; `/api/health` counts a row given the stop's end as waiting, never as deferred; with the organizers' group on Gmail's road the organizers' message leaves by Gmail during the stop; and while «Trimite un mesaj participanților» draws «Mailgun e oprit acum…» its dialog offers no «Trimite acum», so the press queues and the message waits (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Cere reconfirmarea» with «Vin» and a ready reminder text; a queue where every send to many — the cancellation, «Detalii actualizate», the reminder, the organizers' message, the thank-you and «s-au deschis înscrierile» — waits behind the registrations' own emails
